section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: Debate 1: Autonomous Robotaxis (Waymo/Tesla) — Disruption Threat vs. Uber Marketplace Partner
section_4b_pre_print_debates.content: The foremost strategic debate among institutional portfolio managers is how autonomous driving will reshape Uber's terminal value. While bears argue that dedicated OEM robotaxi fleets or Google Waymo could attempt to bypass rideshare aggregators, bulls emphasize that Uber's existing partnerships with Waymo (Austin, Atlanta, Phoenix) and Cruise prove that AV developers require Uber's massive demand aggregation, dynamic routing, and fleet balancing infrastructure. CEO Dara Khosrowshahi's commentary on AV network economics will be the conference call's focal point.

Long-only institutions argue that at 15.24x forward earnings with an active $7B share repurchase authorization, Uber is significantly undervalued relative to mega-cap tech peers.
